key_messages: [AI estimate, replace] MPC is 5% of the plan but only 18% funded against 28% overall: cash is being squeezed, not protected. Preference evidence (90%) needs verifying.

key_messages: [AI estimate, replace] Cash reaches ~900,000 people but mostly as paper vouchers inside sectors; no MPC line and no pooled fund, so flexible cash has no home in the plan.

key_messages: [AI estimate, replace] Largest MPC line in the set ($593M) and only ~8% funded, against 36% for the plan. Cash is being rationed while need is near-universal.
barriers: MPC badly underfunded; WFP cash cuts (75,000 families); crossing closures and thin supply; cash-out costs; no local co-chair.

key_messages: [AI estimate, replace] Mature cash architecture (government co-led CWG, JMMI, social registry) but MPC is small and has no 2026 FTS requirement; gDCF figures need reconciling with FTS.

key_messages: [AI estimate, replace] MPCA is the first-line modality on paper, endorsed by the HC, but only ~36% of the $97M line is funded and the pooled fund tags none of it.

key_messages: [AI estimate, replace] MPCA is small (2.9% of prioritised needs) but funded slightly better than the plan, with a working CWG and JMMI and a national NGO co-chair.

key_messages: [AI estimate, replace] MPC is 4% of a $2.9bn plan but ~81% funded; the bigger cash story sits with Collective Sudan's shared FSP and payment platform.

key_messages: [AI estimate, replace] $183M MPC ask (6.3% of plan, up 26%) is only 20% funded, worse than the plan, while 85% of households name cash as their top priority.

key_messages: [AI estimate, replace] Cash is near-invisible in the plan (MPC 0.2%, unfunded on FTS) yet partners delivered ~$11M in cash in H1 2025. The plan understates cash; the $100M US-OCHA allocation review is the lever.
barriers: No aggregated CVA figure in the HNRP; MPC unfunded two years running; CWG handover to government (MASSAH) incomplete; no preference or cost-efficiency data.

key_messages: [AI estimate, replace] MPC was the only line to keep its 2026 budget, but is ~15% funded on the single-cluster view. Strong CWG capacity (OCHA/GiveDirectly, CashCap) is ahead of the money.
barriers: ~$1bn gap on the revised plan; access limits in the east; sectoral CVA not visible on FTS; no recent preference data; no local co-chair.

key_messages: [AI estimate, replace] Cash is about a third of the LRP and the CWG is among the best documented anywhere, but regular cash is ~10% funded and transfers sit far below the MEB.

key_messages: [AI estimate, replace] MPC is modest (5.5%) and a third funded in a plan only 23% funded. The Donor Cash Forum with CALP/CashCap support is the main lever.
